preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
For each test case, N and M must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x_i <= N and 0 <= y_i <= N for x_i, y_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices within the range from 0 to N.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not valid_sequence else True
postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists, output -1; otherwise, output the lexicographically smallest sequence.

postconditions.expression: len(sequence) == N and all(isinstance(x, int) and x > 0 for x in sequence)
postconditions.description: The output sequence must contain N positive integers.

postconditions.expression: all((x_i, y_i) in edges for x_i, y_i in sequence_edges)
postconditions.description: The output sequence must correspond to the edges in the input graph.
